official_nav_reference.risk: NEVER add modeled OpenAI stake on top of existing SVF2 NAV

method.fundNAV_replacement: new_SFTBY_lookthrough_NAV = old_SFTBY_NAV - current_SBG_attributable_OpenAI_in_SVF2_embedded_in_base_NAV + scenario_SBG_attributable_OpenAI_value_at_matching_date + other_verified_changes; preserve rest_of_SVF2, debt, cash, fund fees, FX and taxes exactly once
method.deltaNAV: delta_SFTBY_NAV = net_SBG_attributable_delta_OpenAI_security_fair_value + verified_delta_other_assets - verified_delta_net_debt - fees_taxes_and_financing_adjustments; NEVER add gross OpenAI 13% as extra holding
method.gross_only: hypothetical gross stake value = valuation_scenario_USD * 0.13; sensitivity = -0.04 * valuation_scenario_USD * 0.13, provided 13% held fixed
method.time_policy: all equity, FX, debt, portfolio holdings, preferred rights and reporting inputs must be synchronized and no later than scenario as_of
rules: Investment cost USD 64.6B is neither the implied stake fair value nor net parent equity.
Do not substitute March funding postmoney mark as a verified October mark.
SoftBank's approximately 13% interest is not a disclosure of fully diluted current common-equivalent percentage.
Funding underlying stake with debt can increase capital cost independently of OpenAI price.
LTV stress uses adjusted holdings value AND adjusted net debt and 25% normal/35% emergency company policy, not gross asset price alone.
No price target or traversal probability until reconciled NAV and post-IPO securities/ADR ratios exist.

illustrative_scenarios.remarks: Applies Oct 1 approximate 13% to March 31 financing value for sensitivity, not an actual matched-date holding valuation.
April-October funding terms and derivative future do not establish security-specific payoff; not NAV.
